headline: International Flavors & Fragrances Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates
summary: International Flavors & Fragrances reported third-quarter earnings that beat consensus estimates by $0.02, with revenue also topping expectations.
why: IFF is a major global supplier of tastes, scents, and ingredients for consumer goods, serving as a bellwether for consumer packaged goods demand.

impacts.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
impacts.why: Earnings and revenue beat analyst estimates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Beating consensus earnings and revenue estimates generally triggers positive market reactions for the stock.
